official_definition: {During Seal} Plunder - (When Attacks/Blocks) Look at your opponent's hand, and discard one Magic card among them. You can immediately activate the discarded Magic card's Main/Flash effect without paying the cost.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Plunder] or [Plunder: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Plunder]", "give [Plunder]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
